params.text:
The contributor with the most commits to the AndroidSlidingUpPanel project is 'tokudu' (antonlopyrev@gmail.com) with 150 commits. This is significantly more than the second-highest contributor, Sergii Pechenizkyi, who has 11 commits. The project has a total of 61 contributors, with the top 5 being:

1. tokudu - 150 commits
2. Sergii Pechenizkyi - 11 commits
3. ChaYoung You - 10 commits
4. NeilMajumder - 9 commits
5. Cody Young - 4 commits (tied with several others)

The project has 361 total commits, meaning tokudu alone contributed approximately 41.6% of all commits to the project.
